## TechScout authority checklist

- [ ] Fast behavior and claims remain explicitly synthetic.
- [ ] Verified claims are limited to the bounded Hero Case and preserve provider/cache, Docker, and enforced install-network dependencies.
- [ ] pgvector and unknown candidates remain research-only unless a reviewed fixture and decision are included.
- [ ] No synthetic diagnostic is presented as product-effect, benchmark, or resume evidence.
- [ ] No secret, provider body, local output, cache, or private evaluation data is included.
- [ ] Public contracts, docs, examples, and generated snapshots are updated where relevant.
- [ ] Security-sensitive or destructive changes have explicit review and safe rollback notes.
